Are you planning to tune in to his farewell episode tomorrow night?

They're trying to buy the midterms by tricking you into voting against your own interests.

And they're using shady campaign finance tactics to hide their involvement from the publi

This is what Jeff Bezos doesn't want you to know: the super-rich have a secret playbook to get away with paying almost nothing in taxes.

Video

Effective tax rate paid by Jeff Bezos from 2014 to 2018: 0.98%

Effective 2025 federal tax rate paid by Amazon: 1.4%

Typical tax rate paid by the average American: 14.5%

Just thought I should point that out.

Reminder that Amazon...

-Helps fuel ICE's deportation machine

-Donated $1M to Trump's inauguration

-Scrapped plans to display tariff costs after pressure from Trump

-Shelled out $75M for the Melania movie

-Donated to Trump's WH ballroom

-And reportedly wants to reboot The Apprentice with Don Jr. as host

Remember: Wealth cannot be separated from power.

We're seeing in real time how the extreme concentration of wealth is distorting our politics, rigging markets, and granting unprecedented power to a handful of people.

Taxing the rich isn't just an economic issue, it's a defense of our democracy.

In his first term, Trump ended an early pandemic warning program just months before the onset of COVID-19.

Last year, he and Elon Musk gutted funding for agencies like the CDC and USAID that respond to infectious diseases like hantavirus and Ebola.

The pro-virus president.

The Supreme Court's right-wing majority is nothing but a bunch of corrupt GOP partisan hacks. 

The next president must enact court reform.

Video

Tax cuts can't help people who don't have an income, but a generous tax financed welfare state can.

Today's primary between Thomas Massie and his Trump-backed challenger is the most expensive House primary in history. The pro-Israel lobby has spent millions on this race and others across the country. But it's not the only Big Money group trying to buy the midterms. Watch.
Friends, I’ve been around politics for over 50 years. I’ve never seen anything as brazenly crooked and corrupt as what Trump and his cronies did today.
Kudos to Zohran Mamdani for exposing the lie behind Ronald Reagan’s most famous quote. This is what true public service looks like.
I've worked for three presidents, including one Republican. No previous administration was this awash in corruption and conflicts of interest.
This gave me chills. Watch.
With inflation skyrocketing and the Iran War dragging on, Trump was hoping for a big win from his visit to China. That didn't happen.
This monologue from Hannah Einbinder on the show “Hacks” perfectly encapsulates the frustration many people feel about AI. What are your thoughts?

Are you sick and tired of dealing with soaring rent and crumbling buildings? Do you want to level the playing field between landlords and tenants? Then it’s time to join a tenant union. Tara Raghuveer explains.

Tennessee State Rep. Justin Jones is one of my personal heroes. I recently had the chance to speak to him about the racist redistricting plot being enacted in his state and others in the South. Republicans are trying to bring us back to the Jim Crow era that so many fought (and died) to end.
